title: S0136 (126th General Assembly): Dismissal of pending gun possession charges

votes.motion: House: Override Veto By The Governor

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Amended, 2025-05-07; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess126_2025-2026/prever/136_20250507.htm (LegiScan doc 3231297))
provenance.note: Text read is the Senate 'Amended' print of 2025-05-07 (House amendments), not an enrolled text; later amendments are not in the text read. The only recorded vote is Senate 2nd reading (2025-02-25). Added subsection (B) is new matter; subsection (A) (expungement of one earlier conviction) is existing law, only relabeled. The same (B) also says a handgun charge brought together with another offense from the same facts is not dismissed until those are resolved, then dismissed and expunged if no earlier expungement under (A).

operative_text: Section 1 (Section 17-1-65): (B) The State must dismiss all charges pending against a person for unlawful possession of a handgun pursuant to Section 16-23-20 if the charges occurred prior to the enactment of the S.C. Constitutional Carry/Second Amendment Preservation Act of 2024, notwithstanding the savings clause contained in SECTION 25 of that act. ... Dismissal pursuant to this section may not serve as a basis or support for any civil action due to the arrest.
